title: erigeron remyi
intro: Erigeron remyi, commonly known as Hawaiian fleabane or island daisy, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional Hawaiian medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Erigeron remyi include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Erigeron remyi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects.
